args.command:
Set-Location "C:\workspace\13_benchmark\GPT-6 in Coding\benchmark\runs\mai-code-1.1-flash\A5-wordfreq-cli"; @'
import subprocess
import sys
import wordfreq

assert wordfreq.tokenize('Hello, world! Hello.') == ['hello', 'world', 'hello']
assert wordfreq.tokenize("'''") == []
assert wordfreq.tokenize("don't stop rock'n'roll") == ["don't", 'stop', "rock'n'roll"]
assert wordfreq.top_words('b b a a c', 2) == [('a', 2), ('b', 2)]
assert wordfreq.top_words('z z z y', 10) == [('z', 3), ('y', 1)]
assert wordfreq.top_words('', 5) == []

proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'wordfreq.py', '-n', '2'], input='b b a a c', text=True, capture_output=True)
assert proc.returncode == 0 and proc.stdout == 'a\t2\nb\t2\n' and proc.stderr == ''
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'wordfreq.py'], input='', text=True, capture_output=True)
assert proc.returncode == 0 and proc.stdout == '' and proc.stderr == ''
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'wordfreq.py', '-n', '0'], input='x', text=True, capture_output=True)
assert proc.returncode == 2 and proc.stdout == '' and proc.stderr
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'wordfreq.py', '-n', 'abc'], input='x', text=True, capture_output=True)
assert proc.returncode == 2 and proc.stdout == '' and proc.stderr
print('ok')
